subject: general
question: For the given tire size, as per specification as 205/55R16, what is the width of the tire?
solution:
The correct answer is __205 mm.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 205/55R16__ is a tire specification indicating its dimensions and type.
 
• The number 205 represents the width of the tire in millimeters.
 
• This width is measured from sidewall to sidewall.
 
• 55 is the aspect ratio, which is the height of the sidewall as a percentage of the width.
 
• R indicates radial construction, which is the most common type of tire construction.
 
• 16 represents the diameter of the wheel in inches that the tire is designed to fit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Aspect Ratio:**

 
 
• The aspect ratio is calculated by dividing the tire's height by its width.
 
• Lower aspect ratios typically provide better handling but a stiffer ride.
 
 
 
• **Radial Tires:**
 
 
• Radial tires are constructed with reinforcing cords placed radially, perpendicular to the direction of travel.
 
• They offer better durability and performance compared to bias-ply tires.
 
 
 
• **Wheel Diameter:**
 
 
• The wheel diameter is the size of the wheel that the tire is designed to mount on.
 
• It is measured in inches and impacts the overall fitment and performance.
